label: GTR registrar lifecycle and revocation model

states.name: issued
states.description: Registrar admission or metadata update has been submitted or approved but is not yet active in a published GRID release.
states.entryEvidence: GRID application, Data Maintenance Request, or approved metadata submission

states.name: active
states.description: Registrar is discoverable in GRID and may be relied on within declared scope subject to verifier policy.
states.entryEvidence: Published GRID release with active lifecycle status and authority evidence

states.name: suspended
states.description: Registrar or verification material is temporarily restricted because of evidence gaps, metadata staleness, incident review, key compromise, or governance action.
states.entryEvidence: Suspension notice, incident record, stale metadata finding, or governance review record

states.name: revoked
states.description: Registrar authority, GRID participation, or verification material has been withdrawn and should not support new automated reliance.
states.entryEvidence: Revocation notice, withdrawal record, supersession record, or legal mandate withdrawal evidence

states.name: expired
states.description: Registrar metadata, key material, or credential status has exceeded its declared validity period or freshness requirement.
states.entryEvidence: Expiry timestamp, stale freshness check, or status source result

transitions.trigger: GRID admission approved and release published
transitions.actor: GRID governance authority or delegated publication service
transitions.evidenceRequirement: approved registrar application, authority evidence, scope declaration, verified metadata, and release record
transitions.notes: Active status should remain scoped to the declared jurisdiction, register type, and capabilities.

transitions.trigger: Registrar signing key, DID, endpoint, or metadata publication channel is suspected compromised
transitions.actor: Registrar, GRID technical operator, or governance authority
transitions.evidenceRequirement: incident notice, affected key identifier, timestamp, and interim relying-party behavior
transitions.notes: New DIA verification should deny, warn, or route to review until replacement material is published.

transitions.trigger: GRID record or key material exceeds freshness or validity policy
transitions.actor: GRID harvester or verifier freshness check
transitions.evidenceRequirement: freshness timestamp, policy threshold, release version, and verifier check result
transitions.notes: Low-impact effects may warn while high-impact effects should require review.

transitions.trigger: Registrar remediates evidence gap, rotates keys, or resolves governance finding
transitions.evidenceRequirement: remediation record, replacement key or metadata, approval record, and updated GRID release
transitions.notes: Decision receipts should reference the post-remediation release.

transitions.trigger: Legal mandate withdrawn, registrar superseded, participant withdraws, or eligibility is revoked
transitions.actor: Member State, competent authority, or GRID governance authority
transitions.evidenceRequirement: withdrawal notice, mandate change, revocation decision, and archived GRID release record
transitions.notes: New automated reliance should be blocked unless a profile defines a special transition or successor authority path.

transitions.trigger: Fresh metadata, status, or key material is published and accepted into a GRID release
transitions.evidenceRequirement: updated metadata, signature validation result, release record, and lifecycle status update
transitions.notes: Verifier caches should revalidate before admitting new effects.
